MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader address a practical next step after my camcorder purchase: storing and transferring footage, provided the card is compatible.",
    "The Echo Show 8 and smart plug feel like useful additions to my Alexa-enabled television setup because they offer a screen for controls and voice control for a lamp."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; familiarity does not create a need for another streaming device.",
    "The charging cables, tablet, and headphones do not address a current need suggested by my television and camera purchases.",
    "The smaller Echo Show and Echo Dots fit my interests, but I would choose the Show 8 this time rather than buy several devices for overlapping purposes."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when its purpose differs from what I currently need.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched to accessories and personal devices without a clear connection to equipment I own or a task I want to accomplish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent camcorder purchase makes compatible storage and footage-transfer accessories especially relevant right now.",
    "What I already own matters: an additional device should add a useful capability rather than repeat or downgrade an existing one.",
    "Interest in several Alexa devices does not mean I want them all; I would choose the screen-equipped device that best fits my immediate purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my home-video and Alexa interests but missed the distinction between useful additions, redundant devices, and electronics without a current purpose."
}
